title: Drupal scan runs out of heap in intra-component lineage scope cache
description: CLI 0.0.28 scan of corpus repo drupal (229 files, 3 MB) exhausts a 2 GB heap in data_flow. Trigger: core/.phpstan-baseline.php (34k lines, no function headers). enclosingScopeFinder caches a scope text per header-less line that runs to EOF: quadratic memory.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: enclosingScopeFinder (src/data-flow/intra-component-lineage.ts) cached a joined scope text per scope start. A line with no header above it is its own scope start and its scope runs to EOF, so core/.phpstan-baseline.php (34k lines, no function/class headers) retained O(lines^2) bytes. Fix: cache scope end lines only, join text on read, compute ends with a brace-depth min segment tree and a Ruby end-line index. Drupal now scans at 512 MB (386 MB RSS). Eight corpus repos byte-identical. PR pending.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done in scanner PR #110 (merged into develop a08a57b0), released in @dataparade/cli 0.0.28 on 2026-10-23. Drupal scans in 13 s at 260 MB in a 2 GB container (was out of memory at 2.2 GB).
